description_en: Deletes all device whitelists under a system version or application version
description_zh: 删除系统版本或应用版本下的所有设备白名单
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc delete-version-all-white-devices --project-id P0VFCREU --version-type FOTA --version-id 12345 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVersionAllWhiteDevices

parameters.description_en:
The version type. Valid values:

- **FOTA**: system upgrade
- **APP**: application upgrade.
parameters.description_zh:

- **FOTA**：系统升级
- **APP**：应用升级
